title: Let’s pick a derogative term right here and now for people who just crank out soulless slop with AI.
author: PoopsMcScoots
selftext:
There’s clearly a rift in the group between people who use AI and people who just prompt and copy.

Some people are trying to make actual games and putting craftsmanship into it.

And some people are just telling an agent “make me a game” then saying a tech demo that it shits out is a “game” they “made”.

And that later group is the exact same people flooding the market with clones of every successful indie game.

So let’s give them a name so we can make that distinction and separate ourselves from the cancer.

Here’s my suggestions:

“one-prompter”

“Slop-dev”
